Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 29 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Sunita - 26 years, daughter
Look: green saree
3. Anita - 65 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Vikram - 30 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater
5. Hema - 27 years, friend
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Sunita stands in the courtyard. Anita, Vikram and Hema stand near her.]

Sunita: "Vikram, what's the plan today?"

[Sunita washes clothes in a bucket.]

Vikram: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Karan stands in the living room. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Karan pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Anita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Karan sips red wine.]

Karan (excited): "What happened?"

[Karan drinks a beer.]

Karan: "Really?"

[Karan staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Karan: "Hmm, I see."

[Karan and Mother clink their glasses.]

Anita: "Exactly right."

[Karan walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Karan: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 3: The main road - Day

[Karan stands on the road. Anita and Hema stand near him.]

Anita: "Hema, look over here."

[Karan's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Karan (laughing): "This is amazing!"

[Karan's car crashes into a pole.]

Hema: "I'm ready!"

[A dog runs in front of Karan's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Karan: "Really?"

[Karan loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Karan (gently): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
